items.name: wordigo.app
items.description: Main project for Wordigo, an English learning tool designed to enhance language skills.

items.name: SpeakEaseAI
items.description: An app for learning English through custom topic conversations with AI. It adjusts to your English level and generates a score based on your performance. ¡Ganadora del 2° lugar en la hackathon de midudev y Vercel! 🏆

items.name: vip-nextjs
items.description: An web app for learning English vocabulary, idiom and phrase. Built on NextJS, Tailwindcss

items.name: meowlearn-english-app
items.description: This is a Next.js app for learning English, featuring lessons, challenges, and progress tracking

items.name: English-Janala
items.description: An interactive English vocabulary learning platform for all ages — kids to IELTS/TOEFL candidates. Features lesson journeys, quiz mode, flashcards, typing challenge, leaderboard & age-based personalization. 🌐 https://english-janala-azure.vercel.app

items.name: minewords
items.description: MineWords - A Minecraft-themed English learning app for kids. Vocabulary, speaking practice, quests, and gamification built with Next.js.

items.name: murmura
items.description: Browser-based language learning app for Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, German, Italian and English: JLPT/TOPIK/HSK/CEFR learning paths, script and vocabulary drills, spaced repetition, gamified progress and text-to-speech. Next.js static export with a Convex backend.

items.name: ruskiy
items.description: Adaptive Russian language learning platform for English speakers — powered by spaced repetition (FSRS), AI-driven session composition, and pronunciation coaching. Full-stack monorepo with Next.js web app, React Native mobile app, Go API, and Python ML service.
